Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/instance_qutebrowser__qutebrowser-f8e7fea0becae25ae20606f1422068137189fe9e/qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml:
   340	  desc: >-
   341	    Enables Web Platform features that are in development.
   342	
   343	    This passes the `--enable-experimental-web-platform-features` flag to
   344	    Chromium. By default, this is enabled with Qt 5 to maximize compatibility
   345	    despite an aging Chromium base.
   346	
   347	qt.highdpi:
   348	  type: Bool
   349	  default: false
   350	  restart: true
   351	  desc: >-
   352	    Turn on Qt HighDPI scaling.
   353	
   354	    This is equivalent to setting QT_ENABLE_HIGHDPI_SCALING=1 (Qt >= 5.14) in
   355	    the environment.
   356	
   357	    It's off by default as it can cause issues with some bitmap fonts.
   358	    As an alternative to this, it's possible to set font sizes and the
   359	    `zoom.default` setting.
   360	
   361	qt.workarounds.remove_service_workers:
   362	  type: Bool
   363	  default: false
   364	  desc: >-
   365	    Delete the QtWebEngine Service Worker directory on every start.
   366	
   367	    This workaround can help with certain crashes caused by an unknown QtWebEngine bug
   368	    related to Service Workers. Those crashes happen seemingly immediately on Windows;
   369	    after one hour of operation on other systems.
   370	
   371	    Note however that enabling this option *can lead to data loss* on some pages (as
   372	    Service Worker data isn't persisted) and will negatively impact start-up time.
   373	
   374	qt.workarounds.locale:
   375	  type: Bool
   376	  default: false
   377	  backend: QtWebEngine
   378	  desc: >-
   379	    Work around locale parsing issues in QtWebEngine 5.15.3.
   380	
   381	    With some locales, QtWebEngine 5.15.3 is unusable without this workaround.
   382	    In affected scenarios, QtWebEngine will log "Network service crashed,
   383	    restarting service." and only display a blank page.
   384	
   385	    However, It is expected that distributions shipping QtWebEngine 5.15.3
   386	    follow up with a proper fix soon, so it is disabled by default.
   387	
   388	## auto_save
   389	
   390	auto_save.interval:
   391	  type:
   392	    name: Int
   393	    minval: 0
   394	    maxval: maxint
   395	  default: 15000
   396	  desc: Time interval (in milliseconds) between auto-saves of
   397	    config/cookies/etc.
   398	
   399	auto_save.session:
   400	  type: Bool
   401	  default: false
   402	  desc: >-
   403	    Always restore open sites when qutebrowser is reopened.
   404	
   405	    Without this option set, `:wq` (`:quit --save`) needs to be used to save
   406	    open tabs (and restore them), while quitting qutebrowser in any other way
   407	    will not save/restore the session.
   408	
   409	    By default, this will save to the session which was last loaded. This
   410	    behavior can be customized via the `session.default_name` setting.
   411	
   412	## content
   413	
   414	content.autoplay:
   415	  default: true
   416	  type: Bool
   417	  backend: QtWebEngine
   418	  supports_pattern: true
   419	  desc: >-
   420	    Automatically start playing `<video>` elements.
   421	
   422	content.cache.size:
   423	  default: null
   424	  type:
   425	    name: Int
   426	    none_ok: true
   427	    minval: 0
   428	    maxval: maxint64
   429	  desc: >-
   430	    Size (in bytes) of the HTTP network cache. Null to use the default value.
   431	
   432	    With QtWebEngine, the maximum supported value is 2147483647 (~2 GB).
   433	
   434	content.canvas_reading:
   435	  default: true
   436	  type: Bool
   437	  backend: QtWebEngine
   438	  restart: true
   439	  desc: >-
   440	    Allow websites to read canvas elements.
   441	
   442	    Note this is needed for some websites to work properly.
   443	
   444	# Defaults from QWebSettings::QWebSettings() in
   445	# qtwebkit/Source/WebKit/qt/Api/qwebsettings.cpp
   446	
   447	content.cache.maximum_pages:
   448	  default: 0
   449	  type:
   450	    name: Int
   451	    minval: 0
   452	    maxval: maxint
   453	  backend: QtWebKit
   454	  desc: >-
   455	    Maximum number of pages to hold in the global memory page cache.
   456	
   457	    The page cache allows for a nicer user experience when navigating forth or
   458	    back to pages in the forward/back history, by pausing and resuming up to
   459	    _n_ pages.
   460
